title: The ameliorating effect of withaferin A on high-fat diet-induced non-alcoholic fatty liver disease by acting as an LXR/FXR dual receptor activator.
authors: Shiragannavar, Varsha D; Sannappa Gowda, Nirmala G; Puttahanumantharayappa, Lakshana D; Karunakara, Shreyas H; Bhat, Smitha; Prasad, Shashanka K; Kumar, Divya P; Santhekadur, Prasanna K
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Withaferin A作为LXR/FXR双受体激活剂改善NAFLD，虽含分子对接但核心是疾病表型与信号通路，非TF-DNA互作建模，方法浅且对象偏离。
abstract: Introduction: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) incidence has been rapidly increasing, and it has emerged as one of the major diseases of the modern world. NAFLD constitutes a simple fatty liver to chronic non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), which often leads to liver fibrosis or cirrhosis, a serious health condition with limited treatment options. Many a time, NAFLD progresses to fatal hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Nuclear receptors (NRs), such as liver X receptor-alpha (LXR-alpha) and closely associated farnesoid X receptor (FXR), are ligand-inducible transcription factors that regulate various metabolism-associated gene expressions and repression and play a major role in controlling the pathophysiology of the human liver. Withaferin A is a multifaceted and potent natural dietary compound with huge beneficial properties and plays a vital role as an anti-inflammatory molecule. Methods: In vivo: Swill albino mice were fed with western diet and sugar water (WDSW) for 12, 16, and 20 weeks with suitable controls. Post necropsy, liver enzymes (AST, ALT, and ALP) and lipid profile were measured by commercially available kits using a semi-auto analyzer in serum samples. Liver histology was assessed using H&E and MTS stains to check the inflammation and fibrosis, respectively, using paraffin-embedded sections and mRNA expressions of these markers were measured using qRT-PCR method. TGF-beta1 levels in serum samples were quantified by ELISA. In vitro: Steatosis was induced in HepG2 and Huh7 cells using free fatty acids [Sodium Palmitate (SP) and Oleate (OA)]. After induction, the cells were treated with Withaferin A in dose-dependent manner (1, 2.5, and 5 muM, respectively). In vitro steatosis was confirmed by Oil-Red-O staining. Molecular Docking: Studies were conducted using Auto Dock Vina software to check the binding affinity of Withaferin-A to LXR-alpha and FXR. Results: We explored the dual receptor-activating nature of Withaferin A using docking studies, which potently improves high-fat diet-induced NAFLD in mice and suppresses diet-induced hepatic inflammation and liver fibrosis via LXR/FXR. Our in vitro studies also indicated that Withaferin A inhibits lipid droplet accumulation in sodium palmitate and oleate-treated HepG2 and Huh7 cells, which may occur through LXR-alpha and FXR-mediated signaling pathways. Withaferin A is a known inhibitor of NF-kappaB-mediated inflammation. Intriguingly, both LXR-alpha and FXR activation inhibits inflammation and fibrosis by negatively regulating NF-kappaB. Additionally, Withaferin A treatment significantly inhibited TGF-beta-induced gene expression, which contributes to reduced hepatic fibrosis. Discussion: Thus, the LXR/ FXR dual receptor activator Withaferin A improves both NAFLD-associated liver inflammation and fibrosis in mouse models and under in vitro conditions, which makes Withaferin A a possibly potent pharmacological and therapeutic agent for the treatment of diet-induced NAFLD.
abstract_zh: 引言：非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）的发病率迅速上升，已成为现代世界的主要疾病之一。NAFLD涵盖从单纯性脂肪肝到慢性非酒精性脂肪性肝炎（NASH）的病变谱系，后者常导致肝纤维化或肝硬化，这是一种治疗选择有限的严重健康状况。NAFLD时常进展为致命性肝细胞癌（HCC）。核受体（NRs），如肝X受体α（LXR-alpha）及其密切相关的法尼醇X受体（FXR），是配体诱导型转录因子，调节多种代谢相关基因的表达和抑制，并在控制人类肝脏病理生理学中发挥重要作用。Withaferin A是一种多方面的、强效的天然膳食化合物，具有巨大的有益特性，并作为抗炎分子发挥关键作用。方法：体内实验：将Swiss白化小鼠喂食西方饮食和糖水（WDSW）12、16和20周，并设置合适的对照组。尸检后，使用市售试剂盒通过半自动分析仪测定血清样本中的肝酶（AST、ALT和ALP）和脂质谱。使用H&E和MTS染色评估肝脏组织学，分别检查炎症和纤维化，使用石蜡包埋切片，并通过qRT-PCR方法测量这些标志物的mRNA表达。通过ELISA定量血清样本中的TGF-beta1水平。体外实验：使用游离脂肪酸[棕榈酸钠（SP）和油酸（OA）]在HepG2和Huh7细胞中诱导脂肪变性。诱导后，以剂量依赖性方式（分别为1、2.5和5μM）用Withaferin A处理细胞。通过油红O染色确认体外脂肪变性。分子对接：使用Auto Dock Vina软件进行研究，以检查Withaferin A与LXR-alpha和FXR的结合亲和力。结果：我们通过对接研究探索了Withaferin A的双重受体激活特性，该特性有效改善高脂饮食诱导的小鼠NAFLD，并通过LXR/FXR抑制饮食诱导的肝脏炎症和肝纤维化。我们的体外研究还表明，Withaferin A抑制棕榈酸钠和油酸处理的HepG2和Huh7细胞中的脂滴积累，这可能通过LXR-alpha和FXR介导的信号通路发生。Withaferin A是已知的NF-kappaB介导炎症的抑制剂。有趣的是，LXR-alpha和FXR的激活均通过负调控NF-kappaB来抑制炎症和纤维化。此外，Withaferin A处理显著抑制TGF-beta诱导的基因表达，这有助于减少肝纤维化。讨论：因此，LXR/FXR双重受体激活剂Withaferin A在小鼠模型和体外条件下改善NAFLD相关的肝脏炎症和纤维化，这使得Withaferin A可能成为治疗饮食诱导的NAFLD的强效药理学和治疗剂。
